command: python3 scripts/rule6_mutation_runner.py SPEC.json OUT.json; each mutant runs npx vitest run --project <project> <tests> (named per mutant below)
method: each mutant replaces old with new exactly once in file (the spec generator asserts each occurs exactly once), runs its tests, and the runner restores the file from git in a finally block; killed means at least one test ran and failed with a non-zero exit. Per-entry mutants drop one re-admitted entry, or append one left-out entry, where the classifier reads its Stage-2 list (public-source-classification.ts), since the policy file itself is governed and never edited; the three any-depth mutants admit docs-tree text under one left-out root at any depth; the detector mutants drop one configuration detector from the Stage-2 detectors (screen.ts); the code-change mutants undo the 3.0.0 binding, the bindable 2.0.0 path, the earlier-version test and the bound version in each restart explanation.

firstRun.record: the runner log only (one line per mutant: id, outcome, failed-test count); its JSON output was overwritten by this run
firstRun.repair: screen-loader-restart-unbound survived: no test reached screenLoaderOf with a run bound to 1.0.0 or 2.0.0. The commit after it adds that test (screen-source-readmission-v3.test.ts, "the step screen loader for a run bound to an earlier version"), and this run re-ran every mutant at that commit.
